summary: The prepared base still added a replicated TP1 shared-expert output at full scale before a deferred downstream SUM. The correction pre-scales that output by moe_ep_size only when the post-experts all-reduce is skipped, and shares the logic between normal and dual-stream forwards. A deterministic regression failed on the base and passes after the change.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression; all five cases failed because the prepared base lacked the corrected reduction/add path. Raw output: reports/j-fdfa8fbde7de/failing-before.log

Five passing cases covering skipped reduction, an independent downstream-SUM reference, executed all-reduce, flag-off/single-rank boundaries, and gfx950 GPU arithmetic. Raw output: reports/j-fdfa8fbde7de/passing-after.log
99 related tests and 140 subtests passed for reduction-skip context and communicator fusion gates. Raw output: reports/j-fdfa8fbde7de/related-tests.log
Repository formatting, lint, test-registration, and static checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-fdfa8fbde7de/pre-commit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), an independent float64 CPU reference showed max absolute error 15.59580647945404 for the unscaled replicated contribution and 5.401670932769775e-07 after 1/8 scaling. Raw output: reports/j-fdfa8fbde7de/gpu-evidence.log

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the actual eight-rank NCCL/RCCL reduce-scatterv serving topology was not reproduced.
DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat and GLM-5.2 weights were unavailable; no full-model generation or semantic-accuracy claim is made.
The GPU check validates the per-rank arithmetic and downstream SUM invariant, not transport behavior or a distributed workload.

Two related upstream PRs remain open (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31476 and https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35535); the latter addresses broader CP/DP model paths outside this narrow issue fix.
